name: Home & Trade Calculators
description: Free home, workshop, electrical, and property calculators — BTU, AC tonnage, lumber, deck, voltage drop, refinance, rental cash flow, and more. Runs in your browser.

tools.name: BTU Calculator
tools.description: Estimate room cooling BTU from size, ceiling height, sun, people, windows, and a kitchen load, plus AC tons.

tools.name: AC Tonnage Calculator
tools.description: Convert home square footage, insulation, and climate into cooling tons and BTU, rounded to the next half ton.

tools.name: CFM Calculator
tools.description: Calculate airflow CFM from room volume and air changes per hour for a fan, hood, or workshop.

tools.name: Air Changes Calculator
tools.description: Find air changes per hour from room cubic feet and fan CFM, plus minutes for one full air change.

tools.name: Lumber Calculator
tools.description: Calculate board feet, linear feet, and lumber cost from thickness, width, length, and board count.

tools.name: Deck Calculator
tools.description: Estimate deck boards, joists, and square footage from deck size, board width, gap, and joist spacing.

tools.name: Spray Foam Calculator
tools.description: Convert wall area and foam thickness into board feet, spray foam kits, and material cost.

tools.name: Miter Angle Calculator
tools.description: Find the miter saw angle and interior corner for a square, hexagon, octagon, or any equal-sided frame.

tools.name: Kerf Calculator
tools.description: See how many pieces a board yields after saw kerf, and how many boards to buy.

tools.name: Ohm's Law Calculator
tools.description: Solve voltage, current, resistance, and watts with Ohm's law from any two electrical values.

tools.name: Voltage Drop Calculator
tools.description: Calculate voltage drop and percent drop for copper or aluminum wire by AWG, amps, distance, and phase.

tools.name: Wire Size Calculator
tools.description: Pick a wire gauge from load amps, run length, voltage, and a maximum voltage-drop percent.

tools.name: kW to kVA Calculator
tools.description: Convert kilowatts to kVA with power factor, and estimate single-phase or three-phase amps.

tools.name: Electricity Cost Calculator
tools.description: Estimate appliance electricity cost from watts, hours per day, and your price per kWh.

tools.name: EV Charging Cost Calculator
tools.description: Calculate electric vehicle charging cost, kWh, and hours from miles, efficiency, and charger kW.

tools.name: Closing Cost Calculator
tools.description: Estimate buyer closing costs from lender fees, title, inspection, appraisal, and prepaid tax and insurance.

tools.name: Down Payment Calculator
tools.description: Compare 3%, 5%, 10%, 20%, and a custom down payment, with loan amount and whether PMI is likely.

tools.name: Refinance Calculator
tools.description: Compare your current mortgage payment with a refinance, including break-even months and total interest.

tools.name: Rental Property Calculator
tools.description: Estimate cap rate, monthly cash flow, cash-on-cash return, and mortgage payment for a rental property.

tools.name: Seller Net Calculator
tools.description: Estimate seller net proceeds after commission, mortgage payoff, closing costs, and repairs.

tools.name: Loan Comparison Calculator
tools.description: Compare two loans side by side on monthly payment, total interest, and total amount paid.

tools.name: Budget Calculator
tools.description: Split monthly income across housing, food, transport, and debt, then see what is left and the savings rate.

tools.name: Vehicle Depreciation Calculator
tools.description: Project car value year by year with a declining-balance depreciation rate.

tools.name: Marketplace Fee Calculator
tools.description: Calculate seller fees, shipping, product cost, net profit, and margin for an online marketplace listing.

tools.name: Tithing Calculator
tools.description: Calculate a tithe or any percent of weekly, monthly, or yearly income.

tools.name: Retirement Calculator
tools.description: Project retirement savings from a current balance, monthly contribution, return, and years.

tools.name: Employee Cost Calculator
tools.description: Estimate fully loaded employee cost from salary, benefits percent, and employer payroll tax.

tools.name: Absorption Rate Calculator
tools.description: Calculate real estate absorption rate and months of housing supply from sales and active listings.

tools.name: Car Trade-In Calculator
tools.description: Use this car trade-in calculator to compare your dealer's trade-in offer with your loan payoff, estimate positive or negative equity, and compare sales tax with and without a trade-in.

tools.name: Business Valuation Calculator
tools.description: Estimate a small-business value from seller earnings and revenue using multiples you choose.

tools.name: Aquarium Calculator
tools.description: Convert tank dimensions to gallons and liters, plus heater watts, water-change volume, and salt dose.

tools.name: Coffee Ratio Calculator
tools.description: Calculate pour-over, French press, drip, cold brew, and espresso water from a coffee dose and brew ratio.

tools.name: 3D Print Cost Calculator
tools.description: Estimate 3D print cost from filament grams, spool price, print hours, printer watts, and electricity rate.

tools.name: Cat Age Calculator
tools.description: Convert cat years and months into an approximate human-equivalent age.

tools.name: Plant Spacing Calculator
tools.description: Count how many plants fit in a garden bed with square or triangular spacing.

tools.name: Compost Calculator
tools.description: Balance browns and greens by volume and see how much to add for a target compost ratio.

tools.name: Hull Speed Calculator
tools.description: Calculate displacement hull speed in knots, mph, and km/h from waterline length.

tools.name: Fuel Mix Calculator
tools.description: Calculate 2-stroke oil for a 50:1, 40:1, 32:1, or 25:1 gas mix in ounces and milliliters.

tools.name: Molarity Calculator
tools.description: Calculate solution molarity from grams and molar mass, or the grams to weigh for a target molarity.

tools.name: Hexagon Quilt Calculator
tools.description: Estimate fabric area for hexagon quilt pieces from side length, seam allowance, and how many hexes you need.
